name: Tocinoic acid
summary: Tocinoic acid is a peptide oxytocin receptor antagonist which is used in scientific research. Intracerebroventricular injection of the drug has been found to block the prosocial behavior induced by the serotonin releasing agent MDMA without affecting baseline social behavior in animals. Similar findings have been made for the non-peptide selective oxytocin receptor antagonist L-368899.
